answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the delta of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The raven lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the orchard is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
